title: V2.2 whole-bundle validation and capability-bound partition amendment

authorization.authorization_scope: One fresh formal lifecycle after preregistration, implementation tests, environment verification, source freeze and collision preflight all pass.

attempt_registry.resume_rule: A platform interruption may resume only the same attempt when the frozen recovery implementation proves identical commit, environment, seed roots, paths, committed bytes and ledger prefix. Otherwise publish the frozen terminal disposition and stop.
attempt_registry.pre_generation_collision_rule: All four formal roots must be absent and no artifact, process record or launch marker may already name the attempt. Any collision stops before generation.

immutable_history.forward_only_rule: V2.2 uses new files, directories, commits, protocol identity, seeds, data identities and attempt roots. No predecessor commit, branch, tag, release, report, manifest, artifact or log may be deleted, overwritten, amended, rebased, squashed or retroactively edited.

exposure_disclosure.known_v021_root_cause: The V2.1 runner sliced a valid center_development subset and then applied the whole-bundle formal row-count contract to that subset.
exposure_disclosure.known_v021_trigger: prefix_pack.csv had 7200 valid center rows while the inherited whole-bundle contract required 71400 rows.
allowed_information: the disclosed structural root cause and test gap
the immutable V2, V2.1 protocol, implementation and terminal hashes
outcome-independent schemas, formulas, thresholds, endpoints and gates already frozen before V2.1 execution

scientific_inheritance.inheritance_rule: Except for the new protocol and attempt identity, fresh seed roots and generated identities, additive whole-bundle-to-partition validation capability, typed partition-contract terminal classification and forward-only isolation rules in this amendment, every V2 and V2.1 scientific rule remains unchanged.
unchanged: six core generating families and every generating equation and distribution
all seven partitions and their frozen cluster counts
twelve prefix days and eight forecast days with their units
the exact 86 model variants and all features and optimizers
all fit credibility, calibration, issuance and rejection thresholds
all five primary endpoints and secondary endpoints
all eight-family, novel-mechanism and safety gates
placebo, stress-permutation and information-firewall negative controls
success conditions, scored-failure obligations and reporting denominators
scientific_inheritance.omission_rule: An omitted predecessor rule remains binding and cannot be weakened by implementation interpretation.

fresh_generation.seed_derivation: For each named stream, derive the first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA256(synthetic_long_horizon_identifiability_v2_2|seed_root|partition|family_id|zero_based_index|stream_name), interpret as unsigned and reduce modulo 2^63-1. Use numpy.random.Generator(PCG64DXSM) only in the frozen environment.
fresh_generation.freshness_rule: All V2.2 rows, opaque IDs, pair IDs, content hashes, noise realizations, fitted states, predictions and scores must be newly derived from the V2.2 protocol identity and roots. Equality to any registered V2 or V2.1 seed, ID or content coordinate is an integrity failure.

rules: exact frozen column order and no unknown columns
exact protocol, config and attempt identity
exact row counts, key uniqueness and cross-partition opaque-ID uniqueness
exact partition membership, prefix and forecast grids and units
all required numeric values finite and conditional null rules exact
exact 86 variants per cluster and eight forecasts per successful variant
source byte SHA-256 values match the label-free commitments

proofs: each partition has only its declared partition value and exact table-specific cardinality
partition key sets are pairwise disjoint
the union of all partition key sets exactly reconstructs each whole-bundle key set
each partition view binds the five source file hashes and its canonical key-set hash
mutation after capability issuance is rejected

capability_architecture.issuer_rule: Capabilities have exact runtime types and can only be issued by private module factories after all corresponding checks pass.
capability_architecture.pipeline_rule: The V2.2 partition pipeline accepts only ValidatedPartitionView and exposes no formal boolean, truth path, sealed root, outcome frame or scoring parameter.
capability_architecture.truth_order_rule: The required label-free partition capability must exist before open_truth_for_phase can be called.
forbidden_shortcuts: deriving expected counts from observed rows
skipping schema, hash, key, unit or finite-value checks
opening truth to diagnose a label-free contract error

lifecycle_order: static environment, source, history, collision and path preflight without seed consumption
capability-bound center, risk and calibration partition fitting
heldout truth opening and deterministic scoring
exactly one scored or terminal registry
independent post-run hash and history audit

terminal_rules.scored_success: Every unchanged primary endpoint and required family, safety, negative-control, firewall and audit gate passes.
terminal_rules.scored_failure: A valid committed and scored attempt fails one or more unchanged success gates; publish all scores unchanged.
terminal_rules.terminal_inconclusive_not_success: A preregistered scientific availability or fitting condition terminates before prediction; publish only the frozen terminal registry.
terminal_rules.integrity_void: Any config, source, environment, history, path, seed, ID, content, capability, hash, truth-order or commitment violation voids the attempt.
terminal_rules.unclassified_terminal_not_success: A genuinely unregistered pre-prediction exception uses UNKNOWN_PRE_PREDICTION_EXCEPTION and cannot be converted to success.

required_positive_tests: all five whole tables pass exact formal validation at 71400/47600/5950/511700/4093600 rows
the real runner partition path validates center_development at 7200 prefix rows
all seven partitions match exact cardinalities and reconstruct the whole bundle
capability hashes and key proofs are deterministic
truth-open spy observes no truth call before a validated partition view exists
scored and terminal registries are mutually exclusive
required_negative_tests: one missing or extra row in each whole table and partition
wrong or unknown partition and cross-partition reused ID
duplicate, missing, extra or reordered key
wrong protocol, config, attempt or source hash
wrong prefix or forecast grid or unit
missing or nonfinite forbidden values and wrong conditional nulls
85 or 87 variants and missing or extra forecast horizon
forged capability, wrong exact type and post-issuance mutation
V2 or V2.1 seed, ID, content hash or artifact path collision

claim_boundary: Any V2.2 result is limited to the frozen six-core-family synthetic 25-year protocol. It is not evidence of real LFP cells, Hithium products, storage stations or 15-25 year real-world predictive accuracy.
